Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT IMAGE 1, the BACK VIEW running sprite sheet. CAMERA IS BEHIND KAZI: every single frame shows the back of his head, back of his high collar and coat. NO FACE, NO EYES, NO FRONT CHEST, NO FRONT BUTTONS. Keep the exact BACK orientation of image 1 throughout all 18 frames. Image 2 shows the corrected body anatomy and LEFT-HIP sword carry from the side; use it for proportions/weapon only, NEVER its camera direction.
Create 18 distinct compact running frames, 6 columns x 3 rows, wide transparent 3:1 canvas. Keep image2's tall lean torso/legs, modest head relative to body, upright compact gait with small bob, no body stretching. Swept black hair seen FROM BEHIND, charcoal split long coat seen FROM BEHIND, black trousers and boots. Sword stays at his own LEFT hip, which is on IMAGE LEFT in this BACK view. His RIGHT hand reaches across the FRONT of his abdomen to the hilt at LEFT hip, so this hand/right forearm are mostly OCCLUDED by his torso from this BACK camera. His left hand supports sheath at same left hip. Never draw arms crossing the back or put hilt on image right. Keep one thin curved long dark blade/hip weapon, gold hilt, actual length 55-60% standing body height, correctly foreshortened in this straight-back view, never a short dagger. Weapon extends rearward from his LEFT hip, toward back camera, not sideways across back.
Legs alternate compact left and right strides: left heel contact0, left stance1-3, recovery4-8, right heel contact9, stance10-12, recovery13-17. Hands remain at LEFT hip. Restrained small violet sparks, no large effects. Same physical anatomy/scale and grounded baseline all18frames. Body65-70%cellheight with20pxtransparent margins. Real alpha0 background. No floor/shadow/text/grid/watermark. FINAL CHECK: ALL18 characters face AWAY; absolutely no face visible. Do not turn toward the viewer.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Kazi production RUN sheet. CAMERA/ORIENTATION is the highest priority: EVERY FRAME rear three-quarter facing upper-left, showing BACK and LEFT side; no front-facing chest. Image1 is the correct CAMERA DIRECTION reference. KEEP that view for all frames; never copy the side-facing direction from image2. Image2 is the approved new ANATOMY, long curved BLADE and LEFT-HIP hand placement/choreography reference, shown from a different camera; rotate that character/action to image1's angle. Image3 is the original Blue CG motion reference.
18 distinct compact run poses in 6 columns x3rows, full canvas3:1. Compact near-upright run with tall lean torso and legs, moderate head/hair exactly image2 proportions. No horizontal stretch or squat body. Left heel plant0, stance1-3, recovery4-8; right heel plant9, stance10-12, recovery13-17; grounded boot slides backward relative to body during stance. Small <1.5%height headbob, restrained coat/hair. Hands remain at LEFT hip ALL18frames. Body occupies60% cellheight, uniform scale and baseline.
Weapon contract: ONE thin curved dark sword with gold hilt, real blade/hipweapon length55-60% standing bodyheight (about1.5heads), not tiny dagger. Hilt stays at Kazi's ANATOMICAL LEFT hip at ready/run, blade/sheath extends REARWARD. RIGHT hand reaches across FRONT abdomen to grip LEFT-hip hilt, LEFT hand supports sheath at SAME LEFT hip. Front view hilt is imageRIGHT; BACK view hilt is imageLEFT and crossing right forearm is OCCLUDED by torso, never crossing his back. Side ready/run: only right arm visible, left arm/hand hidden by torso/coat. Do not switch hips to expose weapon. Foreshorten accurately from this camera. Keep exact pose/weapon anatomy ofimage2. No extra weapon. Same face/hair, charcoal high-collar splitcoat, white collar, gold buttons, black boots, purple sparks. Rear views show backofcoat and backofhair, NO FACE.
Uniform fixed cellgrid with ONE character percell. Entire blade, body andeffects INSIDE eachcell, at least25transparentpixels clear ofEVERY edge, never clipped/crossing neighbors; shrink whole character uniformly ifnecessary, NEVERshortenblade. TRUEalpha0 transparent background, no floor/shadow/grid/text/watermark. Final camera check: rear three-quarter facing upper-left, showing BACK and LEFT side; no front-facing chest allframes.
